Question Choices: A 1 m x 1 m square is divided into 6 columns and 8 rows. A shaded rectangle covers 4 columns and 6 rows. What fraction of the whole is shaded?
Hints: Count shaded rows times shaded columns and divide by total rows times total columns.
Solution: Total 6 columns x 8 rows=48 tiles. Shaded 4 columns x 6 rows=24 tiles.24/48=1/2.

Question Choices: A large rectangle is 1 m tall and 4 m wide. It is divided into 16 equal small rectangles. The shaded part covers 6 small rectangles. What is the area of the shaded part in square meters? Give your answer as a fraction or mixed number only, no units.
Hints: Find the whole area, then multiply by the shaded fraction.
Solution: Whole area 1 x 4=4 square metres. Shaded fraction 6/16=3/8. Area 4 x 3/8=3/2=1 1/2 square metres.

Question Choices: A large rectangle is equally divided into 20 small rectangles: 4 rows and 5 columns. Each small rectangle is 1/2 m tall and 2/5 m wide. What are the height and width of the large rectangle? Give your answers as numbers or fractions only, no units.
Hints: Divide whole dimensions to find one cell; multiply cell dimensions to recover the whole.
Solution: Height = 1/2 x 4 = 2 m. Width = 2/5 x 5 = 2 m. Keep rows with height and columns with width.

Question Choices: A large rectangle is equally divided into 20 small rectangles. Each small rectangle is 1/2 m tall and 2/5 m wide. What is the area of the large rectangle? Give your answer as a number only, no units.
Hints: Find one tile area, then multiply by the whole or shaded tile count.
Solution: One tile area=(1/2)x(2/5)=1/5 square metre. Whole area=20 x 1/5=4 square metres.

Question Choices: A large rectangle is equally divided into 18 small rectangles. Each small rectangle is 1/3 m tall and 1/2 m wide. The shaded part covers 6 small rectangles. What is the area of the large rectangle? What is the area of the shaded part? Give your answers as numbers or fractions only, no units.
Hints: Find one tile area, then multiply by the whole or shaded tile count.
Solution: One tile area=(1/3)x(1/2)=1/6 square metre. Whole area=18 x 1/6=3 square metres. Shaded area=6 x 1/6=1 square metre(s).
